title: Page-aware SPD accessor caches the page before it is selected
description: The accessor updates its page cache before the selection and ignores an unapplied command, so later successful reads return wrong-page bytes as success.
not_established: Initial DIMM recognition stays original; latency, loader behavior and ROM fit are untested.
remediation: Native B01+B04+B06+B08 batches with per-DIMM witnesses, manager lifetime, SSA status and PEIM failure gates. C1 local, C2 physical. 18 local tests (252 cases) and 7 full-PEIM tests (118 cases).
